pages.content:
About {{ site_name }}

{{ site_name }} is an online store based in {{ country_name }}. We are a small team, and every order is packed and checked by a person.

What we care about

  • Products we would buy ourselves.
  • Prices that stay the same whether or not you are logged in.
  • Answering messages within one business day.

Questions? Write to us at {{ contact_email }} — we read everything.

Replace this page with your own story before you launch.
pages.content_zh:
关于{{ site_name }}

{{ site_name }} 是一家位于{{ country_name_zh }}的网上商店。我们团队不大，每一个订单都由人工打包和复核。

我们在意什么

  • 只卖我们自己也会买的商品。
  • 价格公开透明，登录与否都一样。
  • 消息在一个工作日内回复。

有任何问题，请写信到 {{ contact_email }}，我们都会看。

上线前请把这一页换成你自己的故事。

pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.meta_description: What personal data {{ site_name }} collects and why.
pages.meta_description_zh: {{ site_name }} 收集哪些个人信息，以及为什么收集。
pages.content:
Privacy policy

Last updated: {{ year }}

This policy explains what {{ site_name }} does with your personal information. It applies to this website and to orders placed on it.

What we collect

  • Account details — name, email address, phone number and password.
  • Order details — delivery and billing address, items ordered, and the last four digits of the card used.
  • Technical data — IP address, browser and pages visited, collected by our analytics.

We do not store full card numbers. Payments are handled by our payment provider, which receives your card details directly.

Why we use it

  • To take payment for and deliver your order.
  • To answer your questions and handle returns.
  • To meet our record-keeping obligations under {{ jurisdiction }} law.
  • To send marketing email — only if you asked for it, and every message has an unsubscribe link.

Who we share it with

Only the suppliers we need to run the shop: our payment provider, our delivery carriers, our email provider and our hosting provider. We do not sell your data.

How long we keep it

Order records are kept for as long as tax and consumer law in {{ jurisdiction }} requires. Marketing consent is kept until you withdraw it.

Your rights

You can ask us for a copy of your data, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Write to {{ contact_email }} and we will respond within 30 days.

Cookies

We use cookies to keep you signed in, remember your cart, and measure traffic. You can block them in your browser, but the cart will stop working.

Contact

Questions about this policy: {{ contact_email }}.

This is a starting draft generated by the setup wizard. Have it reviewed against {{ jurisdiction }} privacy law before you launch.
pages.content_zh:
隐私政策

最近更新：{{ year }}

本政策说明 {{ site_name }} 如何处理你的个人信息，适用于本网站以及在本站下的订单。

我们收集哪些信息

  • 账户信息——姓名、邮箱、手机号与密码。
  • 订单信息——收货与账单地址、所购商品，以及支付卡号后四位。
  • 技术信息——IP 地址、浏览器与访问页面，由统计工具采集。

我们不保存完整卡号。支付由支付服务商处理，卡信息直接提交给他们。

使用目的

  • 完成收款与发货。
  • 回复咨询、处理退换货。
  • 履行{{ country_name_zh }}法律要求的记录保存义务。
  • 发送营销邮件——仅在你主动订阅时，且每封都可退订。

共享范围

仅限运营商店所必需的服务商：支付服务商、快递承运商、邮件服务商与主机服务商。我们不出售你的数据。

保存期限

订单记录按{{ country_name_zh }}税务与消费者法律要求的期限保存；营销订阅在你退订前一直保留。

你的权利

你可以要求获取、更正或删除你的个人信息。请写信至 {{ contact_email }}，我们将在 30 天内回复。

Cookie

我们使用 Cookie 保持登录状态、记住购物车并统计流量。你可以在浏览器中禁用，但购物车将无法使用。

联系方式

关于本政策的问题：{{ contact_email }}。

本页由初始化向导生成，仅为初稿。上线前请依据{{ country_name_zh }}的隐私法规审阅。

pages.title: Terms of service
pages.meta_description: The terms you agree to when you order from {{ site_name }}.
pages.meta_description_zh: 在 {{ site_name }} 下单时你所同意的条款。
pages.content:
Terms of service

Last updated: {{ year }}

These terms apply between you and {{ site_name }} whenever you use this website or place an order. Placing an order means you accept them.

Orders

An order is an offer to buy. The contract is formed when we send you a dispatch confirmation, not when you pay. If we cannot fulfil an order, we will cancel it and refund you in full.

Prices

Prices are shown in {{ currency }} and include {{ tax_name }} unless stated otherwise. Delivery is charged separately and shown before you pay. We correct pricing errors: if a price is obviously wrong, we will contact you before dispatch rather than silently charging you.

Payment

We take payment at checkout through our payment provider. We do not see or store your full card number.

Delivery

Delivery times are estimates, not guarantees. Risk passes to you on delivery. See our delivery policy for detail.

Returns and cancellation

Your rights under {{ jurisdiction }} consumer law are not affected by anything on this page. Our returns policy sets out how to exercise them.

Your account

Keep your password to yourself. Tell us at {{ contact_email }} if you think someone else has it.

Liability

Nothing here limits our liability for death, personal injury, or fraud, or any liability that cannot be excluded under {{ jurisdiction }} law.

Changes

We may change these terms. The version that applies to your order is the one published when you placed it.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the law of {{ jurisdiction }}.

This is a starting draft generated by the setup wizard. Have it reviewed by a lawyer in {{ jurisdiction }} before you launch.
pages.content_zh:
服务条款

最近更新：{{ year }}

你使用本网站或下单时，本条款即在你与 {{ site_name }} 之间生效。下单即表示接受本条款。

订单

下单构成购买要约，合同在我们发出发货确认时成立，而非付款时成立。若无法履行订单，我们将取消并全额退款。

价格

价格以 {{ currency }} 显示，除另有说明外已含{{ tax_name }}。运费另计，并在付款前明示。如价格明显有误，我们会在发货前联系你，而不会直接扣款。

支付

结算时通过支付服务商收款。我们不会看到或保存你的完整卡号。

配送

配送时效为预估值，非承诺值。风险自交付时转移。详见配送政策。

退换与取消

本页任何内容都不影响你在{{ country_name_zh }}消费者法律下的权利。具体行使方式见退换货政策。

账户

请妥善保管密码。如怀疑账户泄露，请立即联系 {{ contact_email }}。

责任

本条款不排除或限制依{{ country_name_zh }}法律不得排除的责任，包括人身伤害与欺诈相关责任。

条款变更

我们可能修订本条款。适用于你订单的，是你下单当时公布的版本。

适用法律

本条款适用{{ country_name_zh }}法律。

本页由初始化向导生成，仅为初稿。上线前请请当地律师审阅。

pages.title: Returns and refunds
pages.meta_description: How to return an item to {{ site_name }}.
pages.meta_description_zh: 如何向 {{ site_name }} 申请退换货。
pages.content:
Returns and refunds

Last updated: {{ year }}

Changed your mind

You have 30 days from delivery to return an unused item in its original packaging. Return postage is on you unless the item was faulty or we sent the wrong thing.

Faulty or wrong item

Tell us within 30 days at {{ contact_email }} with your order number and a photo. We pay the return postage and you choose a replacement or a refund. This is in addition to your rights under {{ jurisdiction }} consumer law, which are not limited by this policy.

What we cannot take back

  • Items made or personalised for you.
  • Perishable goods.
  • Sealed hygiene or personal-care items once opened.

How to start a return

  1. Email {{ contact_email }} with your order number and what is wrong.
  2. We reply with a return address and, where applicable, a prepaid label.
  3. Send the item back within 14 days of that reply.

Refunds

We refund to the original payment method within 5 business days of receiving the item. Your bank may take a few more days to show it.

This is a starting draft generated by the setup wizard. Check it against {{ jurisdiction }} consumer law before you launch.
pages.content_zh:
退换货与退款

最近更新：{{ year }}

七天无理由（改变主意）

自签收起 30 天内，商品未使用且包装完好的，可申请退货。除商品有质量问题或我们发错货外，退货运费由你承担。

商品有问题或发错货

请在 30 天内带上订单号和照片联系 {{ contact_email }}。退货运费由我们承担，你可选择换货或退款。本政策不限制你在{{ country_name_zh }}消费者法律下的权利。

不支持退货的商品

  • 定制或个性化商品。
  • 生鲜易腐商品。
  • 已拆封的卫生用品与个护商品。

如何申请

  1. 发邮件至 {{ contact_email }}，说明订单号与问题。
  2. 我们回复退货地址，必要时提供预付面单。
  3. 请在收到回复后 14 天内寄回。

退款

收到退货后 5 个工作日内原路退回。到账时间以银行为准。

本页由初始化向导生成，仅为初稿。上线前请对照{{ country_name_zh }}消费者法律核对。

pages.title: Delivery
pages.meta_description: Where {{ site_name }} ships, how much it costs and how long it takes.
pages.meta_description_zh: {{ site_name }} 的配送范围、运费与时效。
pages.content:
Delivery

Where we ship

We ship across {{ country_name }}. Shipping rates are calculated at checkout from your address, so you see the real cost before you pay.

How long it takes

  • Orders placed before 2pm on a business day are packed the same day.
  • Metropolitan addresses: 1–3 business days.
  • Rural addresses: add 1–2 business days.

These are the carrier's estimates, not guarantees.

Tracking

You get a tracking link by email as soon as the parcel is scanned by the carrier.

Something went wrong

If tracking has not moved for three business days, email {{ contact_email }} with your order number and we will chase the carrier for you.

Update the times and rates on this page to match the carriers you actually use.
pages.content_zh:
配送说明

配送范围

我们支持{{ country_name_zh }}境内配送。运费在结算时按你的收货地址实时计算，付款前即可看到真实费用。

配送时效

  • 工作日 14:00 前下单，当天打包发出。
  • 市区地址：1–3 个工作日。
  • 偏远地址：再加 1–2 个工作日。

以上为承运商预估时效，非承诺时效。

物流查询

包裹被承运商扫描后，我们会立即通过邮件发送运单查询链接。

出现异常

如物流三个工作日无更新，请带订单号联系 {{ contact_email }}，我们会代为催查。

请按你实际使用的承运商更新本页的时效与运费。

pages.title: Frequently asked questions
pages.meta_description: Answers to the questions {{ site_name }} gets most often.
pages.meta_description_zh: {{ site_name }} 最常被问到的问题。
pages.content:
Frequently asked questions

Do I need an account to order?

No. You can check out as a guest. An account just saves your addresses and order history.

Which payment methods do you take?

The methods shown at checkout. Prices are charged in {{ currency }}.

Can I change my order after paying?

If it has not been dispatched, yes — email {{ contact_email }} straight away with your order number.

Do you ship overseas?

Not at the moment. We ship within {{ country_name }}.

How do I return something?

See our returns policy.
pages.content_zh:
常见问题

下单一定要注册吗？

不需要，可以直接以游客身份结算。注册只是方便保存地址与订单记录。

支持哪些支付方式？

以结算页显示为准，均以 {{ currency }} 结算。

付款后还能改订单吗？

未发货前可以，请立即带订单号联系 {{ contact_email }}。

发不发海外？

目前仅支持{{ country_name_zh }}境内配送。

怎么退货？

请参阅退换货政策。
